name: Caranx TAVI robot
full_name: Caranx Medical robotic instrument manipulator for transcatheter aortic valve implantation
group: Caranx Medical (P. Berthet-Rayne, J. Smits, P. Schegg) with Institut Arnault Tzanck, Clinique Pasteur, Emory University, University Hospital Nice
versions: Oct 2023 hybrid-room phantom tests; Dec 2023 - Feb 2024 three in-vivo porcine experiments (CERIMED Marseille); 15 Mar 2024 robot-assisted TAV implantation in a pig; 2025 FRAI paper
devices_driven: Edwards SAPIEN 3 delivery system (flex catheter and handle), intraventricular guidewire, balloon inflation device (Results, Fig. 2)
n_dof_detail: N.R. as a number; four drivers: catheter driver, handle driver (flex and balloon fine-positioning wheels), guidewire driver, inflation driver
translation_detail: friction-roller (friction-wheel transmissions for delivery catheter and guidewire, pretensioned by one screw)
rotation_detail: handle wheels through geared transmissions; catheter roll N.R.
device_range: one delivery-system type per interface (a reusable base with per-device interfaces envisioned)
force_sensing: in-line pressure sensor for pressure-monitored balloon inflation; instrument force sensing N.R.
haptics_leader: single wireless handheld user-input device; teleoperation from a shielded room
imaging_compat: fluoroscopy (wireless pedal) and camera test bench; neural-network feature tracking for closed-loop positioning
sterility: plastic transmission covers on handle wheels; quick-release thumbscrews and spring-loaded sliders; N.R. further
validation_detail: 3 in-vivo porcine experiments with 20 navigation and balloon-inflation sequences (no implant) and one robot-assisted TAV implantation in a pig; phantom operator study and level-3 supervised autonomy with camera and fluoroscopy feedback (Results)
key_numbers: fluoroscopy closed-loop positioning 30 runs without failure, final error 0.5 mm median, min-max range 1.03 mm; calibration about 5 s; autonomy up to 2x accuracy and 4x precision vs manual on phantom (Results)
sim2real_detail: none found (network trained on real fluoroscopy data)
